P1: In the time it took to obtain the 绿色徽章, the last of Kanto's three legendary birds has appeared outside the Power Plant on 10号道路.
P2: Begin with 岩石- and 冰 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 虫-, 草-, 格斗-, 飞行-, and 钢 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider lulling it to 睡眠 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P3: Only Trainers who have proven their worth by earning all 16 Badges are permitted to enter 华蓝洞窟, a mysterious place on the northwest edge of 华蓝市. To get there, visitors must 冲浪 southward from 24号道路.
P4: The mysterious 华蓝洞窟 is a sprawling cave network that extends deep into the mountains outside 华蓝市. It is impossible to navigate the pitch-black cave without the use of 冲浪, 碎岩, and 攀岩, and difficult to do so without 闪光, as well. Before 红莲岛's volcano erupted, it is here that the genetically-engineered Pokémon from the island's Pokémon Mansion fled after escaping the facility.
D3: Southwest area, on the wall surrounded by three breakable rocks (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D4: South-southwest area, next to two large crystals
D5: Southwest area, on a single small crystal next to a large crystal (hidden)
D6: Upper level, east end of the bridge
D7: Upper level, northwest of the bridge
D8: Upper level, on the northern of two crystals in the southeast corner (hidden)

D11:

* Southeast; in the large clearing, on the lone crystal in the southeast corner (hidden)
D12: Southeast; in the large clearing, east-southeast of the ladder (hidden)
D13: Southeast; in the large clearing, near the northeast corner (hidden)
D14: Southeast; in the large clearing, near the lone crystal in the southwest (hidden)
D15:

* Northwest; west-central area

D17: Northwest; north end of the path along the west wall (hidden; requires 碎岩)

* Near the center of B1F, west of the group of five breakable rocks (hidden; requires 碎岩)

P5: Head north and use 冲浪 to reach the northeast corner, and climb up the ladder for a short detour.
P6: Follow the path and use 碎岩 to clear the two breakable rocks. Pick up 招式学习器24（十万伏特）, then backtrack and return to 1F.
P7: 冲浪 westward and climb out of the water. Pick up the nearby 金珠, then climb up the ladder to the southwest.
P8: Use 碎岩 and follow the branching path to its end to find a ＰＰ提升剂. Backtrack to the ladder and return to 1F.
P9: Go south, then head east to find a 全复药 sitting next to the two crystals. Turn north and climb up the nearest ladder.
P10: Search this wide-open area for any stray items, then return to 1F.
P11: Go west and pass under the bridge, then turn south. Loop around and climb up the stairway to reach the bridge. Moving northward, take the right turn to reach a ＰＰ多项全补剂 on a cliff, then the left turn to reach a 海潮薰香 on a narrow trail along the north wall. The north end of the bridge leads to the other end of this narrow trail, which serves as a shortcut to the exit. Return to the south end of the bridge and climb up the ladder.
P12: Head west to reach a fork in the road; turn south, then turn east and clear two breakable rocks to reach an 奇异薰香. Backtrack to the first east turn, then follow the southwest tunnel to the southwest corner and northward along the west wall. Make the first right turn to reach another 高级球. Return to the first fork and go north this time, then turn east. Follow the zigzagging tunnel around to the northwest corner, and climb down the ladder.
P13: Climb down the next ladder to B1F.
P14: Move southward and use 攀岩 to reach an 高级球, then go east and use the move again to grab the 暗之石 in the dead-end to the east. Use Rock Climb again to continue northward past a group of breakable rocks and head east. Turn southward, then take the first path eastward to reach a 活力块. Continue south to the water's edge and use 冲浪 to move northeastward. Cross over the ridge with the two crystals and use Rock Climb to reach the 电力增幅器 in the northeast corner. Jump the nearby ledge and use Rock Climb again to continue southward. Use 冲浪 to collect the 黑色污泥 in the southeast corner, climb the stairway on the east-central hill to meet the Genetic Pokémon.
P15: Begin with 虫-, 幽灵-, and 恶 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 格斗- and 超能力 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P16: After the battle, either use an 离洞绳, or climb up the nearby ladder.
P17: Jump the ledge and use 冲浪 to return to the entrance.
P18: After brief sightings of 水君 in 圆朱市, 湛蓝市, 42号道路, 枯叶市, and 14号道路, its search for a suitable environment comes to an end at Cerulean Cape. As Eusine once said, it seems to prefer "a hilly place, near water... ...Somewhere north."
P19: When you reach the top of the stairway, 水君 lets out a cry just as Eusine arrives. He is out of breath, and reluctantly admits that he is no match for you. He reveals that he has had a feeling since first meeting you in the 烧焦塔 that Suicune would choose you. He encourages you to face the legendary creature, pointing out that it is waiting to battle a worthy Trainer that it can trust to be its partner.
P20: Begin with 草- and 电 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 火-, 水-, 冰-, and 钢 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P21: After the battle, Eusine exclaims that he has never seen a battle so intense. He states that he has no regrets, and bids farewell to you and 水君.
P22: With 赤红 defeated, return to 真新镇 and speak to Professor Oak. He has heard a lot about you, and would like to reward all of your hard work with a gift. He motions to the three Poké Balls on the desk behind him, and gives you the choice of three Pokémon rarely seen in Kanto.
M1: 1 只（Must select the choice of Green Stone）
M2: 1 只（Must select the choice of Red Stone）
M3: 1 只（Must select the choice of Blue Stone）
M4: The same as the traded Pokémon
M5: 1 只（After speaking to Steven in Pewter City）
P23: Having defeated 赤红, return to 金黄市 and visit the Silph Co. building. Inside, you find Steven Stone near the information desk on the east side. He is just ending a phone call, but quickly notices you. Seeing that you have a Pokédex, he realizes that you too are searching for Pokémon, and believes that he can help with that. He poses a question to you: "Let's say that you have stones in front of you. Which color would you pick?" The answer given—green stone, red stone, or blue stone—determines which of the three Pokémon from his native Hoenn region that he offers you.
P24: He advises you to take good care of the young Pokémon, then leaves.
P25: After speaking to Steven in Silph Co., travel to 深灰市 to meet him again. Visit the Pewter Museum of Science to find him engrossed in an exhibit, talking to himself about stars shining in the night sky.
P26: After speaking to Steven in 深灰市, return to the Silph Co. building to find that he is already here. He can now be found near the statue at the entrance. Speak to him to find that he would like to trade Pokémon. He is willing to part with his 铁哑铃 in exchange for a 佛烈托斯. Forretress cannot be found in the wild, but its pre-evolved form, 榛果球, is a common sight when 头锤 trees. His Beldum holds a 觉醒之石.
D25: Northeast house; from Mr. Pokémon, after obtaining a Kanto first partner Pokémon from Professor Oak
D26: Northeast house; from Mr. Pokémon, after obtaining a Kanto first partner Pokémon from Professor Oak
P27: Having received a first partner Pokémon from Professor Oak, return to 30号道路 and visit Mr. Pokémon. When you enter his home, he immediately informs you that he has something that he would like you to have, and was just about to send an email to Professor Oak. He explains that a friend of his from Hoenn delivered this to him, and fetches the 靛蓝色宝珠 / 朱红色宝珠 from the cabinet in the corner. He continues, saying that this gemstone is somehow related to the ancient ruins located past 湛蓝市, but few Trainers can reach the area. Professor Oak thinks highly of you, so Mr. Pokémon is sure that you can solve the mystery of the Orb and the secret of the ruins.
P28: After fleeing from the 烧焦塔 in 圆朱市, the legendary beasts begin racing across the countryside. While 水君 sets off on its own adventure spanning both Johto and Kanto, 雷公 and 炎帝 begin roaming the Johto region. When traveling to a different area, each of the beasts race to a different route. They will also attempt to flee from battle at the first opportunity; this makes Pokémon with trapping Abiliities especially useful, as it blocks the beasts' escape. Speedy Pokémon that act first with 睡眠-inducing moves are also helpful, as both of the beasts can use 吼叫 to escape otherwise. After seeing them in battle, the Pokégear's Map tracks their movements. If defeated, they will reappear in the Burned Tower after entering the Hall of Fame; they must be interacted with here for them to begin roaming again.
P29: Once 雷公 is unable to flee, begin with 地面 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 飞行-, 电-, and 钢 moves to chip away at it even further.
P30: Once 炎帝 is unable to flee, begin with 水-, 岩石-, and 地面 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 虫-, 草-, 火-, 冰-, and 钢 moves to chip away at it even further.
P31: After meeting Steven in 枯叶市, one of the Eon Pokémon begins roaming across Kanto. When traveling to a different area, the Pokémon races to a different route. It will also attempt to flee from battle at the first opportunity; this makes Pokémon with trapping Abiliities especially useful, as it blocks the dragon's escape. Speedy Pokémon that act first with status-inducing moves, like 催眠术, are also helpful. Its location is tracked in the Pokégear's Map once Steven informs you of its presence in Kanto.
P32: Begin with 虫-, 幽灵-, 恶-, 冰-, and 龙 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 草-, 火-, 水-, 电-, 超能力-, and 格斗 moves to chip away at it even further.
